guidance: Tipping is customary at sit-down restaurants.
Check your bill before paying a tip as service charges may have already been adding to your bill.

By French law, a 15% service charge (service compris) is automatically included in the price of every menu item and therefore tipping is not expected. However, you can still award exceptional service with a small tip.
Tipping is expected in Germany for good service.
It is not customary to leave a tip in Japan.

Tipping isn't customary or expected in Switzerland and a service charge will be automatically added to your bill. If you do have exceptional service then you can apply the round up rule to your bill or leave a 5% to 10% tip.
Tipping in Greek restaurants is optional and not mandatory, though a small gesture of appreciation is always welcomed for good service.
